# OINK

> A local-first Hugo theme for technical documentation

## Site index

- [Home page](http://localhost/index.md)
- [navigation.json](http://localhost/navigation.json)
- [Docs](http://localhost/docs/index.md): Build a technical content site. Use shared navigation, multilingual support, and search for documentation, blogs, books, and API references.
- [Book](http://localhost/book/index.md): A practical tutorial for creating clear, beautiful, and maintainable technical content with OINK.
- [Case](http://localhost/case/index.md): Fifteen real sites show how OINK scales from a two-page utility to a multilingual documentation estate and three books.
- [Blog](http://localhost/blog/index.md): OINK engineering stories, immersive guides, and release notes

## Documentation index

- [Introduction](http://localhost/docs/about/index.md): A local-first Hugo documentation framework that evolved from Docsy. Its components remain readable in Markdown. The theme includes its assets. Fifteen production sites use it.
  - [Highlights](http://localhost/docs/about/features/index.md): Compare OINK with an ordinary Hugo theme. Each feature links to its guide.
  - [Cases](http://localhost/docs/about/showcase/index.md): Find the OINK production case closest to your documentation, book, landing page, or interactive tool.
  - [License](http://localhost/docs/about/license/index.md): The theme uses Apache-2.0. The documentation uses CC BY 4.0. Each bundled third-party runtime keeps its own license terms.
  - [Contributing](http://localhost/docs/about/contributing/index.md): Where to report bugs and contribute theme changes, documentation, translations, and regression tests for OINK 1.3.2.
- [Get started](http://localhost/docs/start/index.md): Start from the official OINK Starter. Verify the local site, then customize content, language, brand, integrations, and deployment in that order.
  - [OINK Starter](http://localhost/docs/start/starter/index.md): Create your project site from the official Starter. Change one part at a time: languages, identity, home page, content, navigation, brand, integrations, and deployment.
  - [Repository tour](http://localhost/docs/start/anatomy/index.md): Find the oink-starter files that control identity, languages, home, content, navigation, brand, deployment, and the pinned theme.
  - [From scratch](http://localhost/docs/start/from-scratch/index.md): Build a minimal OINK site in an empty directory. Compare four install methods: Module, submodule, offline archive, and pinned source copy.
- [Authoring](http://localhost/docs/write/index.md): Write documentation pages, blog posts, books, release pages, and API references. Learn the page structure and content organization.
  - [Writing pages](http://localhost/docs/write/pages/index.md): Create a documentation page. Learn where to save it, how to set front matter and anchors, and how links, images, and page-end controls work.
  - [Organizing content](http://localhost/docs/write/organize/index.md): Use the directory structure to create the sidebar tree. Configure `_index.md`, weight, index styles, icons, folding, hidden pages, and documentation paths.
  - [Page parameters](http://localhost/docs/write/frontmatter/index.md): The full front matter table — active page keys and retained 1.x compatibility no-ops, grouped by sidebar, shell, search, output, page end, Book, Expo, landing and release pages.
  - [Blog posts](http://localhost/docs/write/blog/index.md): Set up a blog section. Learn directory conventions, post front matter, featured images, the date-ordered list page, and RSS.
  - [Books](http://localhost/docs/write/book/index.md): Turn a directory tree into a book with `type: book`: chapter numbering, numbered figures and tables, cross-references, generated indexes and whole-book print.
  - [Expo albums](http://localhost/docs/write/expo/index.md): Create an image album, add optional metadata, select a layout, and use the image viewer.
  - [Releases and downloads](http://localhost/docs/write/releases/index.md): Record versions, tags, archive links, checksums, and install commands locally. Release cards, asset tables, download blocks, and index pages use these records.
  - [API reference](http://localhost/docs/write/openapi/index.md): Add an OpenAPI specification to the site. Use bundled Swagger UI or Redoc to render a browsable API reference without a CDN.
- [Components](http://localhost/docs/components/index.md): Find each writing component, from simple examples to detailed examples, with its output matrix, parameters, and limits.
  - [Callouts](http://localhost/docs/components/callout/index.md): Write notes, warnings, and collapsible asides with colors, icons, and titles. Use `> [!NOTE]` blockquotes without shortcodes.
  - [Images](http://localhost/docs/components/image/index.md): Use Markdown image syntax and attributes for captions, sizing, zoom, links, numbering, and Hugo image processing.
  - [Code Blocks](http://localhost/docs/components/code/index.md): Use a Markdown fence and attributes for titles, exact copying, line numbers, highlighting, wrapping, folding, and line links.
  - [Tabs](http://localhost/docs/components/tabs/index.md): Add `{tab=}` to adjacent fences or tables to create tabs. Add a group to enable links, synchronization, and saved selections.
  - [Tables](http://localhost/docs/components/table/index.md): Add attributes to a GFM table for captions, compatibility matrices, field lists, numbering, or tabs. Wide tables scroll within their own regions.
  - [Fields](http://localhost/docs/components/fields/index.md): Add `{.fields}` to a table to document configuration keys, command flags, and API fields. Entries adapt to narrow screens and have individual anchors.
  - [Steps](http://localhost/docs/components/steps/index.md): Add `{.steps}` to an ordered list for a numbered procedure. Use the steps shortcode when each step needs a table-of-contents heading.
  - [Cards](http://localhost/docs/components/cards/index.md): Add `{.cards}` to a link list to create navigation cards. Use the shortcode for icons, badges, or images.
  - [FileTree](http://localhost/docs/components/filetree/index.md): Write directory listings in a `filetree` fence. Use indentation for depth, trailing slashes for directories, and aligned comments for explanations.
  - [Math](http://localhost/docs/components/math/index.md): Use KaTeX for inline and display mathematics at build time. Readers download no script.
  - [Mermaid](http://localhost/docs/components/mermaid/index.md): Use a `mermaid` fence for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, class diagrams, and state diagrams. Bundled Mermaid follows the color scheme; source diffs show changes.
  - [Presentation](http://localhost/docs/components/presentation/index.md): Cards, disclosures, tabs, and compact procedures across OINK's four visual presets.
  - [PlantUML](http://localhost/docs/components/plantuml/index.md): Use a `plantuml` fence for sequence, class, component, activity, and use-case diagrams. Configure your own PlantUML rendering server.
  - [Markmap](http://localhost/docs/components/markmap/index.md): Use a `markmap` fence for an expandable mind map with zoom controls. Its source remains a readable Markdown outline.
  - [Draw.io](http://localhost/docs/components/drawio/index.md): Display a `.drawio.svg` with an embedded editable copy as an ordinary image. Its edit button opens the Draw.io editor.
  - [ECharts](http://localhost/docs/components/echarts/index.md): Write ECharts options as YAML or JSON in an `echarts` fence. Hugo validates them, and bundled ECharts draws charts that follow the color scheme.
  - [Infographic](http://localhost/docs/components/infographic/index.md): Use an `infographic` fence and AntV template to display a title and items as a flow, timeline, funnel, grid, or hierarchy.
  - [Gallery](http://localhost/docs/components/gallery/index.md): Use a `gallery` fence for a responsive image grid with optional descriptions and links. Images share the page zoom dialog.
  - [Badge](http://localhost/docs/components/badge/index.md): Add a semantic status label beside a feature name, version, or table cell. Choose from five tones; custom colors are not supported.
  - [Kbd](http://localhost/docs/components/kbd/index.md): Use `kbd` with one key name per parameter to display a semantic key sequence. Instructions remain readable in print and Markdown.
  - [Includes](http://localhost/docs/components/include/index.md): Use include to insert a file, param to print a site parameter, and comment to remove a note from every output.
  - [Asciinema](http://localhost/docs/components/asciinema/index.md): Display a .cast terminal recording with selectable text. The theme includes the player and does not use a CDN.
- [Customization](http://localhost/docs/customize/index.md): Configure the site brand, navigation, layout, search, languages, versions, print output, and agent output.
  - [Configuration](http://localhost/docs/customize/config/index.md): Find every site parameter that the theme reads, with its type, default, description, and related guide.
  - [Brand and appearance](http://localhost/docs/customize/brand/index.md): Change the site name, logo, favicon, accent color, light and dark palettes, and fonts. Use configuration and two SCSS entry points.
  - [Home and landing pages](http://localhost/docs/customize/home/index.md): Build a home page from one local YAML file. Add hero, cards, capability panels, timeline, pricing, case studies, and downloads. Reuse these sections on landing pages.
  - [Navigation and menus](http://localhost/docs/customize/navigation/index.md): Configure the navbar menu, dropdowns, section switcher, breadcrumbs, page actions, pager, and footer links.
  - [Layouts and page types](http://localhost/docs/customize/layout/index.md): Select the page shell with `type`. Set sidebar width and icons, outline depth, section index style, and page width.
  - [Search](http://localhost/docs/customize/search/index.md): Enable local search. Control index size and result ranking, and configure useful CJK query matches.
  - [Command palette](http://localhost/docs/customize/panel/index.md): Use one dialog for page search, page actions, and site commands. Open the palette, use its groups, and add custom commands.
  - [Keyboard navigation](http://localhost/docs/customize/keyboard/index.md): Use single-key shortcuts and understand when typing disables them. Disable shortcuts for the site or individual pages.
  - [Languages](http://localhost/docs/customize/i18n/index.md): Add a language and keep translations beside their originals. Configure menus and interface strings per language. Use matching heading anchors across languages.
  - [Versions](http://localhost/docs/customize/versions/index.md): Configure the version switcher and archive banner, and select a deployment layout for multiple documentation versions.
  - [Taxonomies](http://localhost/docs/customize/taxonomy/index.md): Use tags and categories to index pages across directories, with automatic term pages, term cards, rail clouds, and navbar panels.
  - [Repository links](http://localhost/docs/customize/repository/index.md): Connect "edit this page", "open an issue", and "view history" to your repository. Show last-modified information, contributors, and feedback at the page end.
  - [Print](http://localhost/docs/customize/print/index.md): Print one page with the browser's Cmd/Ctrl+P. Use the print output format to combine a section into one continuous document.
  - [AI-agent support](http://localhost/docs/customize/agents/index.md): Publish a `.md` version of each page and an `llms.txt` site index. Let readers open the current page in ChatGPT or Claude.
- [Operations](http://localhost/docs/admin/index.md): Preview, deploy, and maintain a site. Configure comments, analytics, and SEO. Upgrade the theme and diagnose problems.
  - [Local preview](http://localhost/docs/admin/preview/index.md): Preview changes with hugo server and build deployable output with hugo. Neither Node nor a CDN is required.
  - [Deploy](http://localhost/docs/admin/deploy/index.md): Publish public/ to GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or another static host. Set baseURL, review Content Security Policy, verify deployment, and prepare rollback.
  - [Comments](http://localhost/docs/admin/comments/index.md): Use giscus for page comments through GitHub Discussions. Control comments for the site or a page, and match light and dark themes.
  - [Analytics and SEO](http://localhost/docs/admin/analytics/index.md): Configure an optional analytics service. Check the canonical URLs, hreflang links, social cards, sitemap, and robots output that the theme generates.
  - [Upgrade](http://localhost/docs/admin/upgrade/index.md): Pin a theme version, upgrade to 1.3.2, migrate legacy content or a Docsy site, and keep a rollback path.
  - [Troubleshooting](http://localhost/docs/admin/troubleshooting/index.md): Diagnose build, language, search, and platform problems by symptom, cause, and fix. Run checks on your site.
- [Design](http://localhost/docs/design/index.md): OINK's contracts, accepted decisions, dated research, and active proposals in one bilingual section.
  - [Architecture](http://localhost/docs/design/architecture/index.md): Repository assembly, configuration, diagnostics, localization, output, performance, security, CSS, accessibility, and release-state boundaries.
  - [Diagnostics](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/diagnostics/index.md): Invalid input produces visible warnings and safe fallbacks. Checks verify diagnostics and rendered output without aborting on every warning.
  - [Goldmark attributes](http://localhost/docs/design/research/goldmark-attributes/index.md): Repeatable probes of lists, images, tables, passthrough blocks, fences, callouts, and nested containers on Hugo 0.160.1 and 0.164.0.
  - [Knowledge graph](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/knowledge-graph/index.md): A draft three-stage design to generate backlinks and local or global graph views from ordinary Hugo links.
  - [2026-10-18 build baseline](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-18-consumer-baseline/index.md): Local inventory of 37 maintained OINK sites using v1.3.2 and Hugo Extended 0.168.0, with visible warnings and separate publication evidence.
  - [Ink / Terminal experiment](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-05-ink-terminal-experiment/index.md): Explicit experimental presets in real theme output, their design tradeoffs, checks and remaining work.
  - [OINK 1.2 pre-release review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-05-v1-2-release-review/index.md): Local 1.2.0 candidate review, cleanup, compatibility, resource provenance and publication checks, with release boundaries.
  - [Preset acceptance](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-05-visual-presets-acceptance/index.md): Local Paper and Slate verification, real theme output, and bounded browser evidence.
  - [Components](http://localhost/docs/design/components/index.md): The maintainer contract for OINK authoring primitives, validation, Book and release behavior, and output degradation.
  - [Configuration](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/configuration/index.md): Hugo and Docsy-compatible configuration, with a narrow OINK interface and no parallel configuration namespace or global resolver.
  - [Consumer evidence](http://localhost/docs/design/research/consumer-evidence/index.md): A dated consumer corpus survey that informed OINK shells, authoring primitives, and deterministic Book migration rules.
  - [Media convergence](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/media-convergence/index.md): A draft for the remaining convergence between content images, numbered figures, Landing media, and featured-image selection.
  - [2026-08-26 review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-08-26-comprehensive-review/index.md): Evidence-based review of post-v0.7.0 implementation, configuration, outputs, security, tests, performance, bilingual contracts, and the real integration site.
  - [CLI and roadmap](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/oink-cli-roadmap/index.md): The accepted independent CLI boundary and local first-stage scope, with later adoption, theme, migration, and content-model work still proposed.
  - [Markdown-first authoring](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/authoring/index.md): Native Markdown carries common semantics, shortcodes fill capability gaps, and new content models extend shared shells.
  - [Shell and navigation](http://localhost/docs/design/shell/index.md): Navigation authorities, immersive blog presentation, search, actions, taxonomies, indexes, and page-end composition.
  - [CLI maintenance](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/oink-cli-maintenance-roadmap/index.md): Historical R1–R8 requirements for documentation maintenance and Oink Studio, distinct from acceptance evidence and the current reduced CLI contract.
  - [2026-09-19 community review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-09-19-upstream-review/index.md): Evidence, acceptance advice, and focused remedies for community issues 40, 41, 42, 44 and pull request 43.
  - [Config schema](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/config-schema/index.md): Editor schemas generated from existing configuration sources, with a CI gate that prevents drift.
  - [Landing pages](http://localhost/docs/design/landing/index.md): The maintainer contract for landing data, the built-in section registry, language resolution, runtime, accessibility, and outputs.
  - [Visual presets](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/visual-presets/index.md): Paper and Slate ship in 1.2.0; Ink and Terminal are explicitly enabled experiments awaiting design acceptance.
  - [Expo](http://localhost/docs/design/expo/index.md): Define album resources, display modes, image viewing, shared appearance, and static outputs.
  - [2026-09-20 release review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-09-20-release-review/index.md): Five reproduced runtime defects, documentation corrections, validation evidence, and the OINK 1.1 publication follow-up.
  - [CLI contract](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/cli/index.md): Executable ownership, versioned diagnostics, isolated validation, and guarded maintenance plans for the current local CLI candidate.
  - [Component refinement](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/component-refinement/index.md): A staged plan for refining OINK components, adding Markdown presentation variants, and evaluating limited motion across Paper, Slate, Ink, and Terminal.
  - [Migration boundary](http://localhost/docs/design/migration/index.md): Supported source, configuration, and validation boundaries for OINK migration, including the 1.3.1 changes.
  - [Visual presets](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/visual-presets/index.md): Accepted phase-one visual identity and appearance controls, with separate reader style and mode state.
  - [2026-10-03 CLI maintenance](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-03-cli-maintenance-acceptance/index.md): Dated source and binary evidence for the local R1–R8/A18 program, preserving the initial audit, failed trials, and final acceptance scope.
  - [2026-09-29 CLI acceptance](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-09-29-cli-acceptance/index.md): Executed Starter, real-site, offline, upgrade, and reproducible-archive checks for the local CLI candidate, with acceptance and publication recorded separately.
  - [Expo albums](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/expo/index.md): Record the reasons for album bundles, shared appearance, three display modes, and the image viewer.
  - [Blog gallery](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/blog-gallery/index.md): Keep articles as the content model while reusing Expo geometry for a fourth blog index view.
  - [Component refinement review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-25-component-refinement/index.md): Local four-preset component validation, asset measurements, and separately reproduced gallery baseline failures.
  - [2026-10-13 theme review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-13-theme-review/index.md): Reproduced image escaping and interaction defects, their repairs, and local theme and consumer validation.
- [CLI](http://localhost/docs/cli/index.md): An introduction to the optional OINK command-line companion for Hugo sites. The CLI is still a draft.
